Hit follow and share your most UNHINGED tip! Automation comes last, not first. Asking AI for an answer is stage 1. The work gets more useful when you use AI to test ideas, learn your process, and handle bigger jobs with clear rules. The 5 stages: 1. Ask AI: Get an answer. 2. Think with AI: Find gaps in your ideas. 3. Teach AI: Show it how you like work done. 4. Delegate to AI: Give it a meaningful assignment. 5. Automate with AI: Have it repeat the work on a schedule. At stage 2, ask AI to find blind spots and question whether the work needs to exist. At stage 3, give AI context, examples, rules, and feedback. Let it ask questions. Check the output, then save your process as a reusable skill. At stage 4, give AI a real job with several files. Check every figure and piece of evidence before you trust the result. At stage 5, schedule a reliable skill. Start with drafts for human review. Add tools or connectors when the job needs fresh data. videos.caption: Before you build an AI agency, get one small project right. If I were starting from zero, these are the 5 things I'd focus on: 1. Pick one buyer and one painful task. An agency owner chasing client updates gives you something specific to solve. “Businesses that need AI” doesn't. 2. Show a tiny demo. Use sample data and walk through the task from start to finish. Keep the tool tour out of it. 3. Offer a small, paid pilot. Agree on the deliverable, price, timeline and what a useful result looks like before building. 4. Start with people you can reach. Ask how they handle the task today, what breaks and what they've already tried. Let the conversation shape the offer. 5. Measure the change. Compare time spent, errors and review work before and after. Get permission before sharing client details. Your next move: name the buyer, name the task, then start a conversation. #AIConsulting #AIAgency #AIForBusiness #ClientAcquisition Comment CONSULTANT if you're building an AI consulting business.
